messages:
lina.support: heads up - BlueBay trial is hitting onboarding failures. embeddings are returning 429s and occasional 502s during bulk import. renewal touch is in 9 days, so this is high priority :eyes:
omar.cs: Ugh. How big is the import and any error samples we can share with CS/AM?
lina.support: import run ~220 reqs/min in a short burst. sample from logs:
```
HTTP 429 Too Many Requests
{\"error\":\"quota_concurrency_limit\", \"tenant\":\"bluebay_trial\", \"route\":\"/v1/embeddings\"}
```
we also saw some 502s with "worker-pool-empty" when the queue blew up. lots of retries from the SDK.
devin.eng: probable cause is per-tenant concurrency default (10) getting exceeded by parallel batch uploads. queued requests hit worker timeouts -> 502s. mitigation options: temporary tenant concurrency bump + enable burst/dynamic pooling for the tenant on Hosted. can ops apply an override?
omar.cs: that sounds like the right mitigation. CS needs to own customer comms: short apology, describe mitigation, and schedule a technical review. sara.am do you want to own the renewal talk if we offer a credit?
sara.am: yes - I want the comms copy + rough cost delta for any temporary quota bump. for trials we may offer a week extension or a trial credit.
lina.support: paging @naveen.ops to request override for bluebay_trial quota bump to 50 concurrency, burst enabled.
naveen.ops: applying override now: tenant=bluebay_trial concurrency=50 burst=true. Change id: q-2026-06-10-7
alert-bot: Quota override created q-2026-06-10-7 for tenant bluebay_trial by naveen.ops
lina.support: immediate effect observed - 429s dropped from ~18% to <1%, 502s are now rare. p95 latency improved from ~2.2s to ~720ms.
omar.cs: CS comms plan (high level): 1) immediate customer note with apology + short root cause hypothesis + mitigation and owner contact; 2) schedule 30m technical review with eng+support within 24h; 3) offer 1-week trial extension and capture feedback via short form; 4) follow-up RCA + playbook for bulk imports. I'll draft the note.
devin.eng: RCA bullets for customer doc:
- Hypothesis: Parallel bulk imports exceeded the per-tenant concurrency default, causing queueing and worker timeouts.
- Temporary mitigation: quota override to increase tenant concurrency and enable burst pooling.
- Permanent fix plan: raise default concurrency for bulk paths, add tenant-aware autoscaler, and add guardrails for bulk-import SDK calls.
omar.cs: owners: CS (omar) send customer note + meeting invite; Support (lina) confirm ops override + monitor; Eng (devin) deliver RCA draft within 48h; AM (sara) handle renewal commercial options; Ops (naveen) retain override until eng confirms changes. please update this thread when complete.
lina.support: invited customer + AM + Eng to 2026-06-11 16:00 UTC technical sync. invites sent.
alert-bot: Severity label set: P2 (trial-impact - renewal-monitor)
omar.cs: adding feedback capture link to invite: https://forms.redwood/bluebay-onboard-feedback
lina.support: customer replied: "Thanks for the quick fix — we need production guarantees before upgrade, can we get a weekly sync?" tagging AM.
sara.am: noted. will prepare an exec summary and propose a 10% trial credit if they move to paid before renewal.
devin.eng: I'll post the initial RCA draft in this thread EOD tomorrow.
naveen.ops: keeping override q-2026-06-10-7 active until eng confirms permanent config. retention id: q-2026-06-10-7
alert-bot: Change q-2026-06-10-7 retention=on until 2026-06-17
omar.cs: thanks team. CS will send the short customer note now and close after RCA + postmortem + feedback captured. :white_check_mark:
